view_env_state.name: view_env_state
view_env_state.description: Read one recorded state and its observation artifacts. Step -1 selects the latest entry. Embeds policy, agentview, and wrist images when available. Use the calibration-frame images for pixel back-projection; JSON state alone is not enough. Use agentview for global tabletop layout and object locations; use wrist for close-range details near the gripper, occlusions, and container/cabinet interiors.

image_detail.description: full includes policy view; calibrated omits it and keeps calibrated global/wrist views. Original media remain on disk.

back_project_batch.name: back_project_batch
back_project_batch.description: Localize several pixels in one read-only call using back_project.

points.description: Ordered [row, col] pixels from the same camera image.

step.description: Observation step; -1 selects the latest once for the whole batch.

camera.description: Camera used to select all pixels.

resolution.description: Image resolution used to select all pixels.

vla_execute.name: vla_execute
vla_execute.description: Execute a task or subgoal continuously from latest observations within an explicit chunk allowance. Each prediction uses the existing VLA processor and five-action chunk. Planner chooses goals, supervises, switches tools or recovers between segments; no per-chunk Planner call is required. Allowance exhaustion means unfinished, not stage failure. Only native termination establishes task success.

instruction.description: Explicit task or subgoal text, local to this invocation.
